title: getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv underflows when total stalk-per-BDV falls below STALK_BDV_PRECISION, reverting stepGauge and bricking season advancement
description: LibGauge.getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv computes `s.sys.silo.stalk.div(totalBdv).sub(STALK_BDV_PRECISION)` where STALK_BDV_PRECISION = 1e4. The subtraction uses LibRedundantMath256.sub (checked) and there is NO floor/guard ensuring `stalk/totalBdv >= 1e4`. The quotient `stalk/totalBdv` is the average stalk units per BDV unit; it is normally >= the base 1e4, but it can drop below 1e4 if the system stalk-to-BDV ratio is depressed. A depressed ratio is directly reachable post-migration: DT-002/ACC-002 zeroes `s.sys.silo.balances[token].deposited/depositedBdv` for migrated tokens while per-account stalk persists (and DT-001/ACC-001 overwrites per-account stalk), desyncing the global stalk and global BDV totals that feed getTotalBdv() and s.sys.silo.stalk. It is also approachable by large active-stalk burns (mass withdraw/convert) outpacing BDV reduction. When `stalk/totalBdv < 1e4`, the checked .sub reverts. getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv -> updateAverageStalkPerBdvPerSeason -> updateGrownStalkEarnedPerSeason -> stepGauge() reverts, and stepGauge is invoked during sunrise/gm, so every season advance reverts: a protocol-wide temporary freeze until the ratio is externally restored.
impact: Checked-subtraction underflow reverts the seed-gauge update, which runs inside sunrise/gm. Season advancement DoS (temporary protocol freeze) whenever the global stalk/BDV ratio is pushed below 1e4. Immunefi v2.2: temporary freezing of season progression / core protocol function -> High when chained with the migration desync that makes it reachable; standalone (requires the ratio precondition) it is Medium.

ite.intent: Permanently or temporarily halt season advancement, or grief sunrise, via an underflow in the gauge average
ite.technique: Drive the global stalk/totalBdv ratio below STALK_BDV_PRECISION (1e4) so the checked subtraction in getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv reverts
ite.evasion: No min() floor on the quotient before subtracting; the migration accounting desync (ACC-001/ACC-002) supplies the precondition without an attacker

ice_chain.impact: Season advancement DoS / temporary freeze of mints, gauge, and downstream silo accrual
ice_chain.exploit_path: sunrise/gm -> stepGauge -> updateGrownStalkEarnedPerSeason -> updateAverageStalkPerBdvPerSeason -> getAverageGrownStalkPerBdv: stalk/totalBdv < 1e4 -> checked sub reverts
